title: Rich & Comforting
description: Heavy, warming bowls built for indulgence -- thick broths and generous fat.

title: Clear & Delicate
description: Light, restrained broths that lead with clarity rather than richness.

title: Regional Classics
description: The reference-point styles most representative of ramen's major regional traditions.

title: Ramen for Beginners
description: Approachable, widely recognizable bowls -- a good place to start exploring.

title: Bold & Garlicky
description: Assertive, aromatic bowls that don't hold back.

title: Cold-Weather Bowls
description: Hokkaido's own answer to brutal winters -- built to keep you warm to the last drop.

title: Brothless & Different
description: No soup at all -- noodles tossed directly in tare, fat, and toppings instead of served submerged.
